description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific festival in a given year. Use when you need specific details about a festival. Do NOT use for listing multiple festivals; use list_festivals instead.
name: festival_details

date.description: The specific date when the festival occurs.

duration.description: The duration of the festival (e.g., one day, multiple days).

location.description: The primary location where the festival is celebrated.

ruleExplanation.description: The explanation of the rule determining the festival's date.

significance.description: The cultural or religious significance of the festival.

traditions.description: A list of traditional activities or customs associated with the festival.

year.description: The year in which the festival occurs.

title: Festival details
